title: Home-Base Company Model — jam and preserves Signature distribution design
body:
Home-Base Company Model is part of the original Signature distribution-network design for jam and preserves, built for a home-base company that makes product in small fresh batches and sells through independent distributors rather than through a single national chain. The design is original Signature business planning, labelled Signature, and it is not presented as an existing company's operating plan.

The home base is one small workshop with a fixed weekly batch capacity, a single recipe book, and a labelling station. Production is scheduled in weekly runs, each run is dated and batched, and no batch ships until it passes the maker's own visual and scent check. Growth comes from adding distributors, never from rushing a batch.

The design keeps the home base small and the network wide: the maker controls recipe, labelling, and quality, while distributors control local warehousing, delivery routes, and shop relationships. Every tier of the network is documented in this record so the model can be run, tested, and improved without changing the maker's home-base craft.

demo_output: Tier model: 40 cases at 30% margin = 12.0 case-equivalents
